name: The Legend of Stalvan
summary: In Darkshire, The Legend of Stalvan begins with Madame Eva's vision of death for her granddaughter, Alyssa. Her cards and trance leave one name: Stalvan. She sends travelers to the Darkshire Town Hall to search the records.

sections.title: A Vision of Death
sections.body: Madame Eva reads cards and portents for troubled locals in Darkshire. After a terrible disturbance jolts her awake, she draws the Death card for her young granddaughter, Alyssa. Eva enters a deep trance, seeking what the omen means, but finds only one clue: the name Stalvan. Fearing for her family and the town, she asks you to follow that name before tragedy strikes.

sections.title: Inquiries at Town Hall
sections.body: Madame Eva sends you across the square to the Darkshire Town Hall to search its records for Stalvan. There you can speak with Clerk Daltry, who keeps the town's ledgers and public archives. He can help determine whether Stalvan once lived in Darkshire, passed through as a traveler, or is a name buried in Duskwood's past.

faq.answer: Madame Eva is a fortune teller and diviner who lives in Darkshire. She reads cards and enters trances to seek portents and sense magical disturbances across Duskwood.

faq.q: Why does Madame Eva need help?
faq.answer: Madame Eva fears for her granddaughter, Alyssa, after a vision of death. Her cards showed the Death card, and her trance revealed the name Stalvan, so she seeks help investigating.
Clerk Daltry keeps Darkshire's records in the Town Hall. He manages the town's ledgers, registries, and historical documents, and can be asked about unfamiliar names.
The Darkshire Town Hall houses the town's officials, historical records, and the Night Watch's command staff.
Alyssa is Madame Eva's young granddaughter, who lives in Darkshire. Eva's reading warned of a deadly omen for her, tied to someone named Stalvan.

faq.q: Where does this investigation lead next?
faq.answer: Speaking with Clerk Daltry leads you to town records and earlier inquiries. From there, the search reaches across Duskwood and neighboring regions to uncover Stalvan's history and fate.

angles.text: With Duskwood lacking regular army support from Stormwind, Alliance adventurers often help the town's elders and protect families like Madame Eva's.
As a priest on Darkshire's dark roads, you may heed spiritual warnings. Madame Eva's omen of death calls for your pastoral care.
